_note: Second held-out set (b01-b60), written AFTER the sink rules were frozen and never used to tune anything. Realistic framework-style Python/JS (Flask, Django, FastAPI, Express, React). Written by the project team (same authors as the rules), so still an optimistic estimate; project-authored, not from a public benchmark.

def delete_comment(conn, comment_id, author):
    query = f"DELETE FROM comments WHERE id = {comment_id} AND author = '{author}'"
    conn.execute(query)
    conn.commit()

def can_view_invoice(user, invoice):
    return user.id == invoice.customer_id or user.role != "support"

def apply_coupon(cart, request):
    percent = int(request.form["percent"])
    cart.total = cart.total * (100 - percent) / 100
    return cart.total

def make_token(user_id):
    return hashlib.sha1(f"{user_id}:{SECRET}".encode()).hexdigest()
